520	King Saul has mercy on Agag. Having mercy on a cruel one is a Jewish trait, it's our problem in every generation, that we have mercy
521	on cruel people.
522	We think our enemies are like us, that they're nice.
523	They probably want to gain something, that's how our minds work.
524	We don't understand that we are dealing with beasts.
525	Why?
526	Because we judge the enemy by ourselves.
527	But to be king of Israel, you have to understand the gentile.
528	You have to know who the enemy standing before you is.
529	Without mercy, without inhibition, to wipe out Amalek, from child to infant.

531	A bit of their genes, so that he understands them, knows how to look at them, understands a little how the gentile
532	thinks, how the enemy thinks, not only how he thinks himself.
533	Very bold things that the Shem MiShmuel says.
534	But it is broader than that, and it is already written in the Zohar and in many books.
535	The truth is that this is the whole arrival of David HaMelech into the world: three times, three
536	women take initiative and do illegal acts, how shall we put it, non-
537	normative, in order to bring the next generation.
538	Who are the three women?
539	The first is Lot's elder daughter, the second is Tamar, who sat at the crossroads,
540	lay in wait for Yehudah until he came down from the road, and then Peretz was born, the grandfather of Boaz, as we discussed on the eve of
541	Shavuot, and the third is Rut herself.
542	As we said, why on earth would Boaz take her, a poor woman, barefoot, why on earth would he...
543	a convert, why would he take her?
544	She waits for him at the threshing floor and lies at his feet, while he is in the middle of work, and his wife had just died the day before.
545	Women who do things almost by force, in order to advance, to bring into the world what our righteous Mashiach is.
546	Why is that so?
547	It is written in the Zohar, in many books from all generations, the same idea.
548	In order to bring a great soul into the world, you have to cover it with garbage.
549	You have to cover it with refuse, so that the kelipot will allow this soul to arrive.
550	When you want to smuggle goods, how do you smuggle them?
551	Not in diamond wrapping.
552	In what do you smuggle them?
553	In sand, in garbage, to confuse the border guards.
554	To bring into the world the soul of David HaMelech, this soul that will change, that will bring the world to its repair, it can't
555	work in a straight way.
556	You have to blind the kelipot's eyes, you have to confuse them.
557	So what does the Holy One, blessed be He, do?
558	He stirs up such frightening events that the kelipot celebrate and say "Baruch HaShem," and they don't know that inside
